dialogues.speaker: Dilawar
dialogues.text: Hehe, this is the Wikala Funduq, the port's trade hub.

dialogues.speaker: Dilawar
dialogues.text: The total amount of wealth is fixed. When some people make money, some people will lose it.

dialogues.speaker: Dilawar
dialogues.text: Anyone who's able to make money here must have tricks up their sleeves.

dialogues.speaker: Dilawar
dialogues.text: If you approach it too casually... Well, how about you try your luck at the Kalimi Exchange downtown?
